description: Each hexa binary embeds the commit it was built from. It reports when it is behind its own source checkout or a published release, says Unknown when it has nothing to compare against, and gives this advice only at session start and in `hexa doctor`.

specs.description: A clean build from a git tree prints its version and short commit
specs.given: hexa-cli is built from a clean git tree at commit a4d8d3c… with crate version 26.10.0
specs.then: the output is `hexa 26.10.0 (a4d8d3c)`, and the embedded Build has version "26.10.0", commit Some(the full commit hash) and dirty false

specs.description: A dirty build is marked dirty
specs.given: hexa-cli is built from a git tree at commit a4d8d3c… that has uncommitted changes
specs.then: the output contains `26.10.0`, the short commit `a4d8d3c` and `-dirty`, and the embedded Build has dirty true

specs.description: A build outside a git tree claims no commit
specs.given: hexa-cli is built from a source tree that is not inside a git repository
specs.then: the embedded Build has commit None, and the output names the version but no commit and no `-dirty`

specs.description: A clean build is not marked dirty
specs.given: hexa-cli is built from a git tree with no uncommitted changes
specs.then: the output does not contain `-dirty`, and the embedded Build has dirty false

specs.description: The case from Drivers: a binary 47 source commits behind its checkout
specs.given: Build { version: "26.10.0", commit: Some("d4eb586…"), dirty: false } and a Checkout with knows_build true, build_is_ancestor true, source_commits_behind 47, and latest_release Some("26.10.0")
specs.then: the result contains BehindCheckout { commits: 47 } and does not contain Current

specs.description: Only commits that change the binary's sources are counted
specs.given: a build commit that is an ancestor of HEAD, with 30 commits between them, 12 of which change crate sources, manifests, Cargo.lock or hexa-cli/assets/, so the git adapter reports source_commits_behind 12
specs.when: staleness is called with that Checkout
specs.then: the result contains BehindCheckout { commits: 12 }, not 30

specs.description: A docs-only gap is not reported as behind
specs.given: a Build with a commit and a Checkout with knows_build true, build_is_ancestor true, source_commits_behind 0 (HEAD differs from the build only by docs commits), and latest_release equal to the build's version
specs.then: the result contains no BehindCheckout and no Unknown, and every finding's advice is None

specs.description: A binary built from HEAD is not behind
specs.given: a Build whose commit equals the Checkout's head, with knows_build true, build_is_ancestor true, source_commits_behind 0
specs.then: the result contains no BehindCheckout

specs.description: A build commit the repository has, but not on the current branch, is named OffBranch
specs.given: a Build with a commit and a Checkout with knows_build true and build_is_ancestor false
specs.then: the result contains OffBranch

specs.description: An off-branch build is not judged behind and not called current
specs.given: a Build with a commit and a Checkout with knows_build true, build_is_ancestor false and source_commits_behind 5
specs.then: the result contains no BehindCheckout and no Current

specs.description: A repository without the build commit gets no checkout claim
specs.given: a Build with a commit and a Checkout with knows_build false, build_is_ancestor false, source_commits_behind 0, and latest_release Some("26.10.0") equal to the build's version
specs.then: the result contains neither BehindCheckout nor OffBranch

specs.description: A higher published release is reported with its version
specs.given: Build { version: "26.10.0", … } and latest_release Some("26.11.0")
specs.then: the result contains BehindRelease { latest: "26.11.0" }

specs.description: Release ordering compares versions numerically, as in ADR-2609151700
specs.given: Build { version: "26.9.0", … } and latest_release Some("26.10.0")
specs.then: the result contains BehindRelease { latest: "26.10.0" }

specs.description: Equal versions are not behind, whatever the commit
specs.given: Build { version: "26.10.0", commit: Some(any commit), dirty: either } and latest_release Some("26.10.0")
specs.then: the result contains no BehindRelease

specs.description: A lower release is not behind, and the comparison is not lexical
specs.given: Build { version: "26.10.0", … } and latest_release Some("26.9.0")
specs.then: the result contains no BehindRelease

specs.description: No build is behind a release equal to its own version
specs.given: any Build b and any Checkout or None
specs.then: the result contains no BehindRelease

specs.description: The session hook asks the release feed at most once in 24 hours
specs.given: a release answer was cached in ~/.hexa/ less than 24 hours ago
specs.then: no request goes to the release feed, and the cached latest release is passed to staleness

specs.description: A failed or slow fetch is not retried in the same window and does not hold up the session
specs.given: the cache is older than 24 hours and the release feed does not answer within two seconds, or the request fails
specs.when: a session starts, and then another session starts within 24 hours
specs.then: the first session gives up on the fetch after no more than about two seconds, and the second session makes no request to the feed

specs.description: A build with no commit and no cached release is Unknown
specs.given: Build { version: "26.10.0", commit: None, dirty: false }, any Checkout or None, and latest_release None
specs.then: the result contains Unknown { why } with a non-empty why

specs.description: A check that could not be made is never reported as Current
specs.given: Build with commit None and latest_release None
specs.then: the result does not contain Current

specs.description: No comparison is never a pass
specs.given: any Build with commit None, any Checkout or None, and latest_release None
specs.then: the result is non-empty, contains Unknown, and contains no Current

specs.description: hexa doctor prints Unknown
specs.given: a hexa binary built outside a git tree, with no release answer cached in ~/.hexa/
specs.then: the output includes a line saying that whether the build is stale is unknown, and why

specs.description: Checkout-gap advice is one line with the rebuild command
specs.given: Staleness BehindCheckout { commits: 47 }
specs.then: it returns Some(line), the line contains no newline, contains `47`, and contains `cargo build -p hexa-cli --release`

specs.description: Release-gap advice is one line with the update command
specs.given: Staleness BehindRelease { latest: "26.11.0" }
specs.then: it returns Some(line), the line contains no newline, contains `26.11.0`, and contains `hexa self-update`

specs.description: The session-start hook prints one advice line per finding
specs.given: a binary that is behind its checkout and also behind a cached release
specs.then: it prints two lines: one with `cargo build -p hexa-cli --release` and the install path, and one with `hexa self-update`

specs.description: Current gives no advice
specs.given: Staleness Current
specs.then: it returns None

specs.description: Commands other than session start and doctor print no staleness warning
specs.given: a binary that is behind its checkout
specs.when: hexa is called from a per-tool-use hook, or runs any command other than the session-start hook and `hexa doctor`
specs.then: its output contains no staleness advice

specs.description: A binary behind both its checkout and a release reports both
specs.given: Build { version: "26.10.0", commit: Some(c) }, a Checkout with knows_build true, build_is_ancestor true, source_commits_behind 3, and latest_release Some("26.11.0")
specs.then: the result contains both BehindCheckout { commits: 3 } and BehindRelease { latest: "26.11.0" }

specs.description: One finding does not hide another
specs.given: the inputs of S28
specs.then: the result does not contain only one of BehindCheckout and BehindRelease, and does not contain Current

specs.description: Detection is pure and deterministic
specs.given: any Build, any Checkout or None, and any latest_release
specs.when: staleness is called twice with the same arguments, with no git repository or network available
specs.then: both calls return equal results, and neither reads git nor the release feed
